recoveredWithDeterministicIdentity.rule: Legacy recovered data cannot be promoted above inferred unless deterministic userId, sessionId, eventId, and source timestamp all exist.

unknownLegacy.rule: Unknown legacy always remains unknown/archive-only unless deterministic evidence exists.

watchTimeThresholds.zeroDenominatorRule: If contentDurationMs is missing or <= 0, normalized watch percent is unavailable instead of 0.

bounceThresholds.zeroDenominatorRule: If session denominator is missing or unbounded, bounce rate is unavailable instead of 0.
bounceThresholds.futureOnlyRule: Future-only events do not count as failures.

dedupeWindows.linkedGuestUserRule: count once globally and once under best user identity only
dedupeWindows.legacyWeakUnknownRule: count in legacy bucket, not exact user bucket
dedupeWindows.retryReplayRule: retry/replay events do not increment standard counts unless replay is the metric itself

costWeightingRules.route4xxRule: Known validation errors should be nonretryable and mapped before they affect cost risk.

sourceOfFundsRules.sourceTruth: wallet capture and source-of-funds ledger; this ledger documents formula authority without changing GumDrop math

provenZeroRules.displayRule: Missing data renders unavailable/source_missing, not zero.
provenZeroRules.scoreRule: Proven zero can only be scored after bounded successful source evidence.

nonEventScoreRules.visibleHighTrafficEventRule: A visible high-traffic event with no liveness source is source_missing or suspicious_idle, not quiet.

formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: sourceHealth 25 + runtimeHealth 20 + evidenceCompleteness 20 + freshness 15 + costRisk 10 + regressionRisk 10 divided by 100.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Score inputs must keep formal/source/runtime evidence confidence separate.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing required score evidence is missing/stale, not zero, unless a bounded source summary proves zero findings.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep score weight changes centralized in the math ledger and agent-score weights.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Hydrates person metric status from canonical envelopes and source event definitions.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Hydrated metric count and gap count derive from event envelope/source mappings; missing hydration gap count equals missingHydration.length.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: exact/linked/inferred/weak/unknown use canonical confidence weights; weak/unknown legacy cannot become exact.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing hydration is a gap unless proven-zero evidence exists.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Use real missing hydration gaps in debug and score impact; classify future-only exclusions before excluding.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Global summaries use event facts and global/user dedupe normalization.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Global count increments once per canonical count key; linked guest/user actions count once globally.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Weak/unknown legacy counts in legacy buckets, not exact global/user summaries.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: No accepted increment is zero only inside a bounded evaluated source window; missing source is unavailable.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep global/user divergence explanations on every dedupe decision.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Duration normalizer computes active/passive/idle/hidden session buckets.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Session time is active + passive + idle buckets, while user-facing active time uses active bucket only and excludes hidden/background time.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Exact requires validated start/end lifecycle truth; abandoned/timeout is estimated; unknown legacy is unavailable.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Unknown duration is unavailable, not zero.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep page-open time out of active duration unless source proves active foreground interaction.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Bounce status is derived from session lifecycle and engagement events.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Bounce rate requires numerator, denominator, source window, and unavailable behavior for missing denominator.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Exact only when session start and bounce/engaged/closed events are source-linked.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep bounce denominator windows explicit in session validators.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Watch duration comes from media/content exposure duration decisions.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Watch time is media/content exposure only; page time and hidden/background time are excluded.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Exact requires media playback or active content exposure timestamps; legacy without start/end remains unavailable.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing content duration makes normalized watch percent unavailable, not zero.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep watch-time validators rejecting page-open fallback.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Wallet and source-of-funds contracts distinguish purchased, bonus, and reward balances.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: GumDrop balances must preserve paid GD, reward GD, bonus GD, source-of-funds, and confidence.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Balance confidence comes from wallet capture/source ledger truth, not UI display totals.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing balance source is unavailable/source_missing; proven zero requires bounded ledger summary.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Do not change payment or GumDrop math in this ledger pass.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Paid package bonus GumDrops are paid-source; reward GumDrops are non-purchase rewards.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Paid GD, reward GD, bonus GD, source-of-funds, and confidence stay explicit for creator monetization and Fan Pass access.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Exact only from wallet capture/source ledger truth.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing source-of-funds is not zero and cannot authorize paid-source requirements.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep source-of-funds validators as the runtime authority for economy changes.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Creator entitlements map source feature, user, creator, source transaction/event, funds source, and confidence.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Revenue/entitlement metrics require source truth and confidence and must not fake revenue.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Revenue confidence is exact only when source transaction truth exists; inferred/legacy remains lower confidence.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing revenue is unavailable; no dollar claims without billing/export artifact.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep payment runtime untouched and use ledger confidence for reporting only.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Task reward and completion counts hydrate from task lifecycle events.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Task rewards distinguish completion count, reward source, source-of-funds, and confidence.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Exact reward requires task completion/reward source event; weak legacy remains legacy.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing task activity is unavailable unless bounded task window proves zero.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep reward-source GumDrops separate from paid-source monetization formulas.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Chat attempts/sends/blocks use count dedupe and monetization/access contracts.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Chat gating metrics count attempts/success/blocks once by canonical event key and preserve paid-source access confidence.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Access confidence follows entitlement/Fan Pass/source-of-funds truth.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing chat gate evidence is source_missing, not success or zero.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Do not touch chat internals in this formula freeze beyond classification.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Notification prompt/token/targeting events feed liveness and metrics lanes.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Notification liveness needs viewed/attempted/succeeded/failed counts, bounded freshness, and explicit missing/future-only handling.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Exact only from registered notification lifecycle events or validated server materializer snapshots.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Future-only notification events do not count as failures; missing liveness is source_missing.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: SQL/export parity compares source summaries and generated mirror outputs.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Export parity formulas require source, destination, bounded window, confidence, and explicit delta.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: Generated SQL/Data Connect mirror does not outrank verified source truth.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Missing export lane is stale/missing, not zero delta.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep SQL/Data Connect mirror as agent context unless explicitly promoted by cost contract.

formulaAuthorityMap.currentFormula: Legacy events are normalized with lower confidence classifications.
formulaAuthorityMap.canonicalFormula: Legacy recovered data cannot be promoted above inferred without deterministic userId, sessionId, eventId, and source timestamp; unknown legacy remains archive-only.
formulaAuthorityMap.confidenceRule: exact=1, linked=.85, inferred=.6, weak=.35, unknown=0; legacy maxima apply before scoring.
formulaAuthorityMap.zeroOrMissingRule: Unknown legacy is unavailable/archive-only, not zero or exact.
formulaAuthorityMap.nextAction: Keep legacy confidence lower unless deterministic source truth exists.
